movement-along.def: A move from one point to another on the same curve, caused by a change in a variable on one of the axes, such as the good's own price.

shift-curve.def: A move of the whole curve to a new position, caused by a change in something other than the two graphed variables; right means a larger quantity at every price, left a smaller one.

ceteris-paribus.def: Latin for "other things equal": a curve shows how its two variables relate while everything else is held constant.
